name: Massacre Girl
oracle_text:
Menace
When Massacre Girl enters, each other creature gets -1/-1 until end of turn. Whenever a creature dies this turn, each creature other than Massacre Girl gets -1/-1 until end of turn.
blocked_sentences: Whenever a creature dies this turn, each creature other than Massacre Girl gets -1/-1 until end of turn.

needs.what: an unscoped delayed_trigger on `creature_dies` (no `subject`, controller any) that fires only when a CREATURE dies, i.e. the delayed path honouring the event's `was_creature` the way the hosted path does
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `delayed_trigger` accepts event `creature_dies`, but `triggers._delayed_matches` only compares the event type (DIES), half, outcome, subject and controller; the `was_creature` check that makes `creature_dies` mean 'a creature' lives only in `triggers._matches`. zones fires DIES for every permanent put into a graveyard from the battlefield, so a delayed `creature_dies` would also fire on a sacrificed Treasure, a destroyed artifact or enchantment, or a dead land, shrinking every creature each time. `was_creature` is not in `EVENT_BINDING_KEYS`, so a trigger `condition` cannot filter it either. Every shipped delayed dies trigger (Fight for the Throne, Together Forever, Heroic Sacrifice) is scoped to a creature `subject`, which hides the gap
